title: wire header isolation: both port and sim include crypto2dev_wire.h for ABI safety
description: crypto2dev_wire.h is included by both crypto2dev_port.c and crypto2dev_sim.c. Both files compute CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_* request codes using _IOW/_IOR macros over the same struct definitions. This guarantees matching ioctl request codes because the sizes are baked in at compile time. A contributor might suggest moving the struct definitions into port.c and simulator.h separately. That would silently break the ABI if a field is added to one side but not the other. The shared header is the only safe approach for this pattern.
